description: This file defines the SymNode class and installs various magic methods into SymBool, SymFloat, and SymInt classes, related to symbolic computation within PyTorch's FX framework. It includes functions for symbolic math operations, symbolic shape analysis, and integration with torch.fx and sympy.

classes.name: SymNode
classes.description: Represents a symbolic computation node with associated shape environment, type, hint, constant value, and FX node. Supports symbolic math operations, shape analysis, and integration with torch.fx.

classes.name: DynamicInt
classes.description: User API class for marking dynamic integers in torch.compile, compatible with both eager and compile modes.

methods.name: _to_symtype
methods.description: Converts a Python type to its corresponding symbolic type class (SymBool, SymInt, SymFloat).

methods.name: SymNode
methods.description: Class representing a symbolic node with methods for symbolic math, shape analysis, and interaction with torch.fx.

methods.name: wrap_node
methods.description: Wraps a value into a SymNode or returns the constant if already a SymNode with a constant.

methods.name: method_to_operator
methods.description: Maps method names to their corresponding operator functions.

methods.name: _make_node_magic
methods.description: Creates and registers magic methods on SymNode for symbolic operations.

methods.name: _make_node_sizes_strides
methods.description: Creates and registers methods for symbolic shape analysis related to sizes and strides.

methods.name: _make_user_magic
methods.description: Creates and registers user-facing magic methods for SymNode and related classes, handling promotion and constant folding.
